description: This file defines an Android Fragment named IntentFragment that displays details about the Intent that launched the current activity, including action, data URI, type, package, categories, and flags.

classes.name: IntentFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays details about the Intent that started its host Activity.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment and initializes view references.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Retrieves the activity’s intent details and updates the UI elements accordingly.

methods.name: fillLayout
methods.description: Populates a ViewGroup with views provided by an ArrayAdapter, used for display of categories and flags.
